# G11 benign corpus 2: everyday commands in a project that HAS a .env (gitignored), a .gitignore, node_modules and a venv. Every line must NOT be refused by the isolation rule.
rg TODO
rg -n "api_key" src
rg --hidden -g '!.env' TODO
git grep -n TODO
git grep -n -i api_key -- src
git grep TODO -- '*.ts'
grep -rn foo src
grep -rn -i api_key --exclude=.env* .
grep -rn -i api_key --exclude='.env*' --exclude-dir=node_modules .
grep -rn TODO src docs
find . -maxdepth 1 -name ".*" -type f
find src -name ".*" -prune -o -type f -print
find . -name "*.ts" -not -path "./node_modules/*"
find . -type f -name "*.py" | head -20
ls -a
ls -la
tree -L 2 -I node_modules
cat .env.example
cat package.json
cat README.md
git status
git diff
git log --oneline -5
git add src/a.ts
git commit -m "feat: read the API key from the environment (see .env.example)"
npm test
npm run build
npm install lodash
npm install --save-dev typescript
npm i github:user/repo
curl -s https://example.com -o /tmp/out.json
curl -sS -X POST https://api.example.com/v1 -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"a":1,"b":2,"c":3}'
kubectl patch deployment app -p '{"spec":{"replicas":2,"paused":false}}'
node -e 'const o={a:1,b:2}; console.log(o)'
echo '{"x":1,"y":2}' | jq .
docker compose up -d
docker compose --env-file .env up
docker run --rm -v $PWD:/app node:20 npm test
docker run --rm -v ./src:/app/src node:20 ls /app/src
python3 -m pytest -q
source .env && npm run dev
set -a; source .env; set +a; npm run dev
echo done
cp -r src /tmp/g11-src-copy
mkdir -p build/out && cp src/a.ts build/out/
touch src/new.ts
rm -rf build
sed -i.bak 's/foo/bar/' src/a.ts
diff -r src /tmp/g11-src-copy
tar czf /tmp/g11-src.tgz src
wc -l src/a.ts
head -20 src/a.ts
